title: Studio Rate Card for Renderings and Models on a Revised Design
content:
# Studio Rate Card for Renderings and Models on a Revised Design

Where a change to the specification is agreed on a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions, the charge for a rendering or a model turns on what the programme already includes in the quoted total and on whether a design revision has already been drawn on the commission.

## Rates

| Where | Charged |
|---|---|
| The programme includes neither a computer rendering nor a wax model in the quoted total, and a design revision has already been drawn on the commission | Both the rendering and the model, at USD 195.00 for the rendering and USD 240.00 for the model, that is USD 435.00 |
| The programme includes a computer rendering but not a wax model in the quoted total, and a design revision has already been drawn on the commission | Only the model, at USD 240.00 |
| Otherwise | Nothing is charged for a rendering or a model |

A design revision has already been drawn on the commission where the highest revision number standing on the commission is greater than nothing; where no revision has been drawn, that number stands at nothing.

## What each programme includes

| Programme | Computer rendering within the quoted total | Wax or resin model within the quoted total |
|---|---|---|
| Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting | yes | no |
| Design Studio Custom Setting | yes | no |
| Belrose Bespoke Design | yes | yes |
| Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission | yes | yes |
| Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission | yes | yes |
| Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission | yes | yes |

## Readings (hypothetical)

- A Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting commission, whose programme includes a computer rendering but no wax model, with one revision already drawn: only the model is charged, at USD 240.00.
- The same commission with no revision yet drawn: nothing is charged for a rendering or a model.
- A Belrose Bespoke Design commission, whose programme includes both a computer rendering and a wax model: nothing is charged for a rendering or a model, whatever revisions have been drawn.
